technical.summary: Bullish technical setup with golden cross and three white soldiers, but weak trend confirmation (low ADX), negative CMF, and below-average volume limit swing entry conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (384.0) dominates risk assessment; normal yield curve provides limited offset; earnings in 58 days presents moderate event risk but secondary to acute volatility environment.

debate.key_bull_argument: Golden cross + three white soldiers + supertrend bullish + extreme fear contrarian signal create a textbook reversal setup at support (406.18) with asymmetric risk/reward in crisis regime.
debate.key_bear_argument: Macro crisis (VIX 384), negative CMF, weak ADX trend confirmation, below-average volume, zero fundamental conviction, and earnings event risk in 58 days make this a low-probability swing entry despite bullish technicals.
